The specification requires removing head 5 (columns 320:384 removed, keeping 0:320,384:768,...), but the artifact removes head 6 instead — it slices `[0:384]` and `[448:768]` (dropping 384:448, which is head 6) rather than `[0:384]`/`[384:448 excluded]`... i.e. it keeps columns 0:384 and 448:768, dropping the 384:448 block, not 320:384. This violates "Required result" clauses 1–3, which specify exact keep-ranges for `c_attn.weight`, `c_attn.bias`, and `c_proj.weight` corresponding to removing head 5. The comment in the plan even says "remove attention head 6," confirming the wrong head was targeted. Since the shapes after removing any single head are identical (2112, 2112, 704×768), the required shape asserts still pass, but the resulting tensor values are wrong and will fail the grader's bit-exact comparison.
